Privacy Policy

Questions

Before we talk.

What happens in the first call?

We discuss your business, current creative, offer, and goals. Then we explain whether our services fit and what a useful next step could look like.

Which platforms do you run ads on?

We focus on Facebook and Instagram advertising, alongside the creative and social content that support those campaigns.

What budget do I need?

There is no single budget for every business. We review your market, objective, and resources together. Ad spend and service fees are discussed separately before any work begins.

How quickly will I see results?

Timing depends on the offer, audience, budget, and sales process. We test and review performance rather than promising a fixed result or timeline.

How do I contact you?

Email runmoreadsteam@gmail.com, or contact Run More Ads through our linked Instagram and LinkedIn accounts.
